content:
I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
fit_coupon:
- I printed it, but I can't tell you how it came out.
plate:
- the clamp: it fits.
- the bolt's head: it fits in its recess.
- the roof the hole goes through: loose loops and tangles around the hole; hole partly closed.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

reasoning:
I'm weighing two ways to get past the slot in the roof: a sacrificial 0.2 mm bridge layer that gets drilled out afterward, or a stepped bridge where the first layer spans the counterbore and leaves a strip the width of the bolt slot for the next layer to cross.

I'm working out the geometry for the stepped bridge: the first layer opens a strip as wide as the bolt clearance running the full length of the counterbore, so the next layer can bridge across it. The second layer then takes the slot's own shape, with bridges anchored on the first layer's material. Then I'll cut the first layer as a clipped box from the counterbore depth up by the layer height, which I'll keep as a parameter.

Writing the strip cut now: a box the bolt clearance wide, intersected with the counterbore outline so its ends follow the stadium. I'm also deciding whether to keep the coupon, which is optional, and I'll update the manual to match.

{"params": {"clamp_w":{"value":38,"kind":"world","source":"asked","note":"tripod takes a 38 mm plate (Arca-Swiss width)"},"bevel_angle":{"value":45,"kind":"world","source":"guessed","unit":"deg","note":"confirmed by the first plate fitting the clamp"},"bevel_drop":{"value":4,"kind":"world","source":"guessed","note":"confirmed by the first plate fitting the clamp"},"edge_flat_h":{"value":2,"kind":"world","source":"guessed"},"plate_t":{"value":10,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"plate_l":{"value":60,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_l":{"value":15,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bolt_head_d":{"value":15,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"bolt_head_h":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"bolt_len":{"value":10,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"bolt_d":{"value":6.35,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_clear":{"value":6.9,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"head_clear":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"cb_depth":{"value":5.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_len":{"value":20,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"layer_h":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"printer layer height; thickness of the stepped bridge layer"}}, "parts": [{"id":"plate","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat underside on the bed (the head recess opens downward)","use_orientation":"same as printed: bevelled top up, camera sits on top","code":"import math
def build(p):
    W=p.clamp_w; T=p.plate_t; h=p.edge_flat_h; c=p.bevel_drop/math.tan(math.radians(p.bevel_angle))
    pts=[(-W/2,0),(W/2,0),(W/2,h),(W/2-c,h+p.bevel_drop),(W/2-c,T),(-W/2+c,T),(-W/2+c,h+p.bevel_drop),(-W/2,h)]
    body=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(0,0)]).val() if False else None
    body=cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(p.plate_l).translate((-p.plate_l/2,0,0))
    cbl=p.slot_len-p.bolt_clear+p.head_clear
    slot=cq.Workplane('XY').slot2D(p.slot_len,p.bolt_clear).extrude(T)
    cb=cq.Workplane('XY').slot2D(cbl,p.head_clear).extrude(p.cb_depth)
    # stepped bridge: one layer above the recess, open only in a strip as wide as the slot
    step_out=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.cb_depth).slot2D(cbl,p.head_clear).extrude(p.layer_h)
    strip=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.cb_depth).rect(cbl,p.bolt_clear).extrude(p.layer_h)
    step=step_out.intersect(strip)
    return body.cut(slot).cut(cb).cut(step)
"},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat underside on the bed","use_orientation":"dropped into the tripod clamp","code":"import math
def build(p):
    W=p.clamp_w; T=p.plate_t; h=p.edge_flat_h; c=p.bevel_drop/math.tan(math.radians(p.bevel_angle))
    pts=[(-W/2,0),(W/2,0),(W/2,h),(W/2-c,h+p.bevel_drop),(W/2-c,T),(-W/2+c,T),(-W/2+c,h+p.bevel_drop),(-W/2,h)]
    return cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(p.coupon_l)

Print the plate flat, with the underside on the bed. Use 4 walls and 40% infill or more, and no supports. The roof over the recess now prints in two stages: the first layer bridges along the plate and leaves a strip open, and the next layer bridges across the plate onto it. That way no bridge has to end in mid-air at the slot.","parts":["plate"]},{"n":"2","text":"If there are any stray strands left in the slot, trim them with a craft knife. Then push the webcam bolt up from underneath so its head sits in the recess.","parts":["plate"],"hardware":["bolt"],"tool":"craft knife"},{"n":"3","text":"Screw the camera onto the bolt by hand until it sits flat on the plate. Slide it along the slot to balance it.","parts":["plate"],"hardware":["bolt"]},{"n":"4","text":"Drop the plate into the tripod clamp and tighten the knob. Before you let go of the camera, check that it doesn't move.","parts":["plate"]}], "note": "Revision 2 changes only the roof over the head recess: it now prints as a stepped bridge to stop the loose loops in the slot. Nothing else has changed."}
